prior_summary: Object-role relational attention conditions a learned joint-action DDPM on causal robot, drawer, red, blue and fixed-pad tokens. Explicit tool/object, object/target and object/drawer relations coexist with world anchors and sign-invariant rotation matrices. Learned robot-query attention changes focus without discarding background goals. A masked future-object displacement predictor trains the same attended representation.
applicable_conditions: Same Panda workspace and gravity, with causal qpos/qvel, world TCP/red/blue poses, drawer position/velocity and supplied world goals. The full expanded slices support takeover during late drawer pull at d about 0.1863 m, released-handle retreat, red approach/closure/lift, red held descent, red release/retreat, and blue acquisition. Both blocks and the drawer must remain observable. Centimetre-scale demonstrated placement variation is the strongest support; arbitrary recovery or role exchange is not established.
termination_guidance: Primary red subgoal is full rotated-block XY containment on the fixed world pad, red center z strictly between 0.014 and 0.031 m, and drawer position strictly greater than 0.26 m. This is not the end of the retained training slice: continue through release, retreat and blue pickup if requested. Insert-blue can take over in the observed outgoing overlap, even during held-red descent; pass the complete causal state. Near the late boundary, blue is rising around z 0.139-0.146 m and each finger is near 0.0182 m; preserve that inferred grasp. Release, clearance and sustained holds are guidance only, not extra task-success requirements.
limitations: State-based, fixed roles and fixed workspace; no images, visual identification, analytical IK, exact action equivariance, collision guarantee or hard grasp/containment constraint. Quaternion sign invariance applies to representation, not joint-action translation invariance. Future-state supervision shapes an auxiliary prediction, not a simulator. The two-step history cannot resolve every stationary dwell or confirm contact. No tested dropped-block recovery, broad goal relocation or demonstrated final blue insertion within this slice. Interface checking is not performance evaluation.
